description: Plans a self-drive winelands day: picks an efficient order of wine farm visits from a start point, checks each farm is open on arrival, and returns arrival times, drive distances and booking needs. Pass farm ids, or leave empty to auto-pick farms in an area.

farm_ids.description: Farm ids to visit (from search_wine_farms); the order is optimised. Leave empty to auto-pick in an area

minutes_per_stop.description: Minutes spent at each farm. Default 75

start.description: Where the day starts, e.g. the guest's accommodation

name: plan_winelands_day
title: Plan a winelands day route
